name: SIREN HEAD: LEGACY
desc:
Siren Head is a 40-foot-tall humanoid creature with a heavily emaciated, near-skeletal frame covered in dried, mummified flesh the color of rusty metal. We have located its position to be on an island with no population. Containment of the island has been succesful and project "DISTRACTION" has been approved. We will begin populating the island with prisoners and futher studies on the creature will be conducted.

- All characters creatively belong to "Trever Henderson".
- Voice lines are from "David Near".
